name: How do you find the source of water coming up through a concrete slab?

mainEntity.name: How do you find the source of water coming up through a concrete slab?

acceptedAnswer.text: Locating the source of water under a concrete slab typically involves specialized tools and techniques. We use thermal imaging cameras, acoustic leak detection equipment, and moisture meters to pinpoint where water is entering or originating. This non-invasive approach helps identify burst pipes, compromised sewer lines, or issues with the foundation without unnecessary demolition, ensuring precise and efficient repairs.
